edit.description: the load-time refusal over a phase's writablePaths and channel paths
the dialect's one home, beside matchesAny
the refusals, naming the glob and the dialect
the predicate over the two forms

summary: a fence glob opening with ! or holding a brace alternation means a negation or a set elsewhere and a literal here, so chain load refuses it rather than let it silently match nothing

per.section: The entry-scoped write guard is opt-in, and off by default

acceptance: chain load refuses a phase whose writablePaths or channel paths carry a leading ! or a {a,b} alternation, naming the glob and the dialect; every other glob loads unchanged
tests: a writablePaths glob opening with ! is refused at chain load, naming the glob
a channel path holding a brace alternation is refused at chain load, naming the glob
the refusal names the dialect the glob was written in
pins: matchesAny treats * and ** as the only wildcards and a declared literal path matches only itself
notes: `matchesAny` (src/paths.ts) is the one spelling of the dialect the guard, the pending gate and `flume check` share; the refusal belongs beside it, never a second parse at the load site.
